==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:{{DIcon}} I want medicines.
:;(Opens [[shop]])
:'''Rosemary:''' Welcome to Rosemary's Apothecary, where your perfect potion awaits.
:;(Purchase items)
:'''Rosemary:''' If anything feels off, I'll be here to assist straight away.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
:''That aroma, it's pretty soothing... I'm starting to relax.''
:{{DIcon}} This is...?
:'''Rosemary:''' My apologies, I sensed your fatigue and took it upon myself to help.
:'''Rosemary:''' Are you... feeling any better?
:{{DIcon}} It caught me off guard a little...
::'''Rosemary:''' There's no need to be afraid. This is just my regular "Mist Therapy."
:{{DIcon}} I'm feeling... much better.
::'''Rosemary:''' Wonderful. This treatment of mine is called "Mist Therapy." I'm glad it serves you well.
:{{DIcon}} Mist Therapy?
:'''Rosemary:''' Yes. By extracting medicinal essences and blending them with aromatic substances, we create a special "Mist Potion."
:'''Rosemary:''' With each breath, the mist alleviates discomfort, almost imperceptibly. It's a secret art of the Fisalia family.
:'''Rosemary:''' Poison or cure, harm or heal—it lies entirely in the user's intention.
:{{DIcon}} What's your intention then?
:'''Rosemary:''' I'm only trying to help those in need.
:{{DIcon}} You run this place alone?
:'''Rosemary:''' As you may have gathered, I'm a Fisalia pharmacist. Our name isn't exactly welcome here in Ragunna...
:'''Rosemary:''' Rumors about the family echo through the streets—people call us "The Poison of Ragunna."
:'''Rosemary:''' It's sad... they seem to find tales of the Fisalias more interesting than the truth.
:'''Rosemary:''' If someone sees you here, you may find yourself entangled in their rumors as well.
:'''Rosemary:''' I do hope this won't weigh on your mind during your time in Ragunna. You have more pressing matters to attend to.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not one of those people.
:{{DIcon}} I'm not bound by Ragunna's rules.
:'''Rosemary:''' The only rumor that's true—you really are special.
:'''Rosemary:''' Thank you, {{Rover}}.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave 
{{Dialogue End}}
